entries.speaker: Hiding Behind Cover
entries.en: Near cover, press [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] to hide behind it. From[n]there, you can check out what's ahead and[n][clr 2]enemies cannot find you[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Hiding Behind Cover
entries.en: If there is another hiding spot nearby, you can[n]press [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] to jump there instantly.

entries.speaker: Hiding Behind Cover
entries.en: Also, if you are within range of an enemy, you can[n]attack from cover for a [clr 2]guaranteed ambush[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Hiding Behind Cover
entries.en: Make good use of this to gain the advantage.[n]However, be aware that cover cannot be used[n]if an enemy is already chasing you.
